Trump agrees to ethics rules amid crypto bill scrutiny

Donald Trump has agreed to stricter ethics regulations concerning his financial dealings, particularly his cryptocurrency holdings, as a significant US bill related to digital assets approaches a vote. The concession comes amid increased scrutiny of his financial interests. The Independent reported Trump "caves" to the tougher rules, while Euronews stated he "concedes" on ethics as the crypto bill nears a vote.
